sentences.text: Shri K. K. Tiwari, learned Govt. Advocate for the respo Heard o n I.A. No.13735/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Jubair.

02. Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Section 376(3) of the IPC and sentenced to 20 years R.I. with fine for Rs.5,000/- with default stipulation, vide its judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 15.09.222 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO) Act/4th ASJ Shajapur, (M.P.) in S. T. No.08/2019.
03. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that the prosecution witnesses even the victim has not supported the prosecution case.
The appellant has been convicted only for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the IPC on the basis of FSL report.
For the age determination, the trial Court has relied on the school certificate and in that the age of the victim was recorded on imaginary basis.
He submits that appellant is a young boy aged about 22 years and he is in jail since 15.09.20022.
This appeal is of year 2022 and final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future

, therefore,
it is prayed that the substantial jail sentence of the appellant be suspended and he may be released on bail.
04. Per contra, learned GA for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.
We have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record.

0 5 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties and that the final conclusion of this appeal will take considerable time, we deem it fit to allow the application for suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the appellant.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, I.A. No.13735/2023 is allowed and it is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 24.09.2024 and on all other subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf, the execution of substantial jail sentence imposed on the appellant Jubair shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this appeal.
List this matter for final hearing in due course.

.
